step_columns.meaning: the number of the training step, from 0
the scenarios of the step, as family id / wording style, with a space between them
attempts sampled in the step
attempts that the harness lost; they are in no other number
valid attempts that did not pass
mean over the valid attempts of reward / 100 (0 to 1)
pass rate of the step's attempts (the frozen function `pass_rate`; 0 to 1)
groups in the step (scenarios per step)
groups whose rewards are not all equal
kept groups with at least one pass and at least one fail
kept groups in which every valid attempt passed
share of the groups whose attempts all have exactly the same reward (0 to 1)
share of the groups in which all attempts passed or all failed (0 to 1)
valid attempts of the kept groups
tokens that the model wrote in the trained attempts
the GRPO loss of the step (the number that the update makes smaller); 0 when no group is kept
size of the gradient before clipping; 0 when no group is kept
mean absolute difference, over the loss tokens, between the log-probability that the sampler saved and the one of the training pass; empty when no group is kept
malformed assistant messages divided by all assistant messages (0 to 1)
tokens that the model wrote, per valid attempt
tokens that the model wrote, per assistant message
assistant messages per valid attempt
seconds of sampling in the step
seconds of the whole step: sampling and update
the reason if the stop rule ended the run at this step; else empty
